The Air India Cadet Pilot Programme selects candidates who want to become commercial pilots. Selected students complete their Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training first. With training conducted at Air India’s Flying Training Academy in Amravati and partner schools in the United States, the programme is designed to shape future airline-ready pilots from day one.

##### Technical Evaluation Preparation

Our online training prepares you for aptitude assessments covering numerical reasoning, critical thinking, spatial orientation, multitasking, and psychomotor skills. We conduct structured online practice sessions, mock tests, and performance analysis. These sessions help you improve speed, accuracy, and decision-making under pressure. ##### Non-Technical Evaluation Preparation

We provide dedicated airline cadet preparation for group discussions, panel interviews, and personality assessments. - Strong command of written and spoken English

- Medically fit and eligible for DGCA Class 1 Medical

title: DGCA Mock Tests Combined

description:
The **DGCA Combined Mock Test Series** is the most comprehensive online preparation program for aspiring commercial pilots. This all-in-one course integrates **Navigation, Technical, Meteorology, Regulations, Instruments, Mass & Balance, Performance, and Radio Navigation** mock tests, providing complete coverage of the DGCA syllabus. Designed to simulate the actual examination environment, this series helps students strengthen their knowledge, identify weak areas, and build confidence across all subjects.

**Key Sections & Topics Covered:**

**1. Performance:**
Covers takeoff, climb, cruise, descent, landing, en-route operations, lift and drag, flaps, curves, and specimen performance papers.

**2. Radio Navigation:**
Includes ADF, VOR, DME, RNAV, GNSS, ILS, MLS, EFIS, FMS, radar theory, and revision questions to ensure mastery of all radio navigation techniques.

**3. Regulations:**
Tests knowledge of air law, aeronautical information services, air traffic services, operational procedures, search and rescue, international and national regulations, visual aids, and sample papers for exam simulation.

**4. Technical:**
Covers aircraft electrical systems, engines, principles of flight, hydraulics, landing gear, fuel systems, ice and rain protection, pressurization, propellers, and system revisions.

**5. Instruments:**
Includes flight instruments, automatic flight systems, engine instruments, airspeed, altimeters, attitude indicators, gyroscopes, TCAS, radio altimeters, and comprehensive revision papers.

**6. Mass & Balance:**
Tests effects of loading, floor loading, load shifts, CG calculations, MAC %, mass changes, aeroplane weighing, conversions, and specimen examination papers.

**7. Meteorology:**
Covers atmosphere, pressure systems, clouds, humidity, temperature, visibility, winds, turbulence, icing, SIGMET, world area forecasts, climatology, tropical systems, thunderstorms, and aviation meteorology.

**8. Navigation:**
Includes chart theory, plotting, magnetic compass, gyros, flight planning, inflight navigation, projections, radar, radio theory, mass & balance integration, performance navigation, and sample papers.

With **thousands of questions across all sections**, this combined series allows students to practice extensively, track progress, and gain full confidence for the DGCA examination. It is the ultimate preparation solution for aspirants seeking success in **all subjects of the DGCA syllabus**.
